message.description: Send this message after reading (1 to 4096 bytes once trimmed); write --message=<TEXT> for a text that starts with '-'

order.description: Id of an order in the local store

since.description: How far back to read, in minutes (1 to 10080, default 10080)

yes.description: Send --message without asking (required with --output json; human mode never asks)
